findings.one_line: The promised all-sequence sharp minimax regret frontier and exact vanishing criterion are still explicitly open in the unsaturated strict sub-familywise region; the delivered phase results and generic sandwich are a weaker kernel.

The theorem-level positioning should explicitly distinguish the closest accepted-bank policy-regret result and give relevance/comparison sentences for bibliography entries not substantively positioned, rather than leaving the central novelty claim supported only by broad class-level contrasts.
